question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'A person who eats excessively or greedily'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Glutton**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Glutton"** refers to a person who eats excessively or greedily. (पेटू व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** He is such a glutton that he finished the entire pizza by himself in just a few minutes.
 

 
• **"Glutton"** is the correct answer because it perfectly describes someone who overindulges in food or drink. (पेटू व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The glutton at the party consumed more food than everyone else combined.
